summary: Tested the new optional student identity fields (full_name_en, birth_date, birth_place, id_type, id_number, id_expiry_date, marital_status) end to end. Backend: 16 of 16 pytest tests passed. They cover create with and without identity data, dd/mm/yyyy to YYYY-MM-DD conversion, Arabic and English aliases for id_type and marital_status, 400 on a bad date, an impossible date (31/02) or an unknown code, update/clear persistence checked with GET, the GET list and detail fields, the template columns, lenient Excel import (invalid values ignored, numeric id_number handled) and export columns with the Arabic marital label. Frontend (admin, desktop, Playwright): 4 of 4 flows passed. (1) /students add modal: the identity section renders, a student with all fields saved correctly (checked in the DB), and a student with no identity data saved with nulls. (2) /students edit modal: existing values load, and changes plus clearing a field (marital, birth_date set to '') saved. (3) /student-details: student-identity-summary shows the values. student-id-expiry-warning shows orange 'تنتهي خلال 13 يوم' for an expiry 13 days away and red 'منتهية منذ 677 يوم' for a past date. The edit modal loads and saves, and the summary refreshes. (4) /course-students 'إنشاء طالب جديد' form: the identity section is present and the created student had the correct identity data. No functional defects found.

minor.issue: Excel date cells stored as numeric serials (e.g. 37755) rather than date/text are silently ignored because of lenient mode. Real datetime cells and text dates work.

issues: Dates like 2003-05-14 render as '14-05-2003' (bidi reversal of the LTR date inside RTL text). Wrapping the value in an LTR span or using \u200E would keep the YYYY-MM-DD order.
data-testid on the TouchableOpacity does not render in the DOM (RN-web needs testID). The test used the text 'إضافة طالب' instead.

action_items: Optional: wrap identity summary values in LTR so dates show as YYYY-MM-DD
Optional: change data-testid to testID on the add-student-btn in students.tsx

critical_code_review_comments: clean_identity is applied correctly on create, update and import (lenient). PUT passes '' through to clear fields, and the whole edit form is sent, so clearing works.
The summary days calculation uses new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') (UTC midnight) and Date.now(), so the count can be off by one day near midnight local time. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_I* students (pytest), TEST_UI194A/B/C (UI; C was auto-enrolled in 8 courses). All of them, plus ZZTEST991 from the main agent, were deleted via the API, and the remaining student and enrollment documents were removed by id in Mongo.
